pokedexEntries.go: When spotted, this POKéMON escapes backward by furiously boring into the ground with its tail.

pokedexEntries.si: If spotted, it escapes by burrowing with its tail. It can float just slightly using its wings.

pokedexEntries.cr: It hides deep inside caves where no light ever reaches it and remains virtually motionless there.

pokedexEntries.rs: DUNSPARCE has a drill for its tail. It uses this tail to burrow into the ground backwards. This POKéMON is known to make its nest in complex shapes deep under the ground.

pokedexEntries.fr: If spotted, it escapes by burrowing with its tail. It can hover just slightly using its wings.

pokedexEntries.lg: When spotted, this POKéMON escapes backward by furiously boring into the ground with its tail.

pokedexEntries.em: Its drill-tipped tail is used to burrow into the ground backwards. This POKéMON is known to make its nest in complex shapes deep under the ground.

pokedexEntries.dpp: It digs into the ground with its tail and makes a mazelike nest. It can fly just a little.

pokedexEntries.hg: When spotted, this Pokémon escapes backward by furiously boring into the ground with its tail.

pokedexEntries.ss: If spotted, it escapes by burrowing with its tail. It can float just slightly using its wings.

pokedexEntries.bw: It digs into the ground with its tail and makes a mazelike nest. It can fly just a little.

pokedexEntries.b2w2: It creates mazes in dark locations. When spotted, it flees into the ground by digging with its tail.

pokedexEntries.x: When spotted, this Pokémon escapes backward by furiously boring into the ground with its tail.

pokedexEntries.y: It digs into the ground with its tail and makes a mazelike nest. It can fly just a little.

pokedexEntries.oras: Dunsparce has a drill for its tail. It uses this tail to burrow into the ground backward. This Pokémon is known to make its nest in complex shapes deep under the ground.

pokedexEntries.us: It travels by digging through the ground. Diglett and Dunsparce share one another’s tunnels happily.

pokedexEntries.um: When it sees a person, it digs a hole with its tail to make its escape. If you happen to find one, consider yourself lucky.

pokedexEntries.sw: This Pokémon’s tiny wings have some scientists saying that Dunsparce used to fly through the sky in ancient times.

pokedexEntries.sh: The nests Dunsparce live in are mazes of tunnels. They never get lost in their own nests—they can tell where they are by the scent of the dirt.
